docs.summary: Visits everything reachable from a root through instance fields, marking each asset it meets. It follows every field whose type can hold an asset, serialized or not, except ones marked [`NotHeldAttribute`](#api~Prowl.Runtime.NotHeldAttribute). It does not see statics, delegates or what a lambda or async method captured, so an asset held only there should be held with [`Hold`](#api~Prowl.Runtime.AssetDatabase~Hold).
Marks what `value` reaches, and it if it is an asset.
